H01.description: Header comment documenting the host-mode opt-in.

H03.description: Header comment documenting size cap and symlink filtering.

H04.description: Header comment rewording base tree and tar filter description.

H05.description: Header comment documenting harness removal, container hardening and output cap.

H06.description: Header comment documenting node path reading, regression parse_error and refactor semantics.

H07.description: Header comment documenting bounded symlink-refusing reads.

H08.description: Header comment documenting refactor verdict accuracy.

H09.description: Header comment documenting contamination scan changes.

H10.description: Header comment documenting grade.json fields and version history.

H12.description: Imports, version bump and constants (timeouts, caps, harness names) supporting the execution-hardening and related fixes.

H13.description: remove_path chmods every directory entry with os.chmod, which follows symlinks, so an agent-planted link to an outside directory gets that directory's mode changed to 0700.

H14.description: Adds the bounded O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK read_regular helper used by the sandbox-read fixes.

H15.description: copy_tree recreates every symlink verbatim, so absolute or tree-escaping links from the agent's sandbox land in the grading tree and point the tests at host paths.

H16.description: A directory symlink is copied without checking that its target stays inside the tree.

H17.description: A file symlink is copied without checking for an escaping target (and regular files of any size are copied densely).

H18.description: Records the structural check's source path for the refactor hidden-test fix.

H19.description: Counts structural cases for the refactor hidden-test fix.

H20.description: The pytest command honours an agent-written ini file's addopts, so the agent can inject plugins or deselect hidden tests.

H21.description: The grading container runs unnamed with no pid/memory/cpu limits, capabilities intact and a plain timeout without kill-after, so a hung or runaway container cannot be killed or cleaned up.

H22.description: subprocess.run buffers unbounded output and on client timeout leaves the docker container running (no kill/rm), and timed_out only recognises rc 124.

H23.description: def_line opens whatever path the test output names (absolute, above the tree, a FIFO or device) with no bounds, so agent-printed node ids can hang or exhaust the grader.

H24.description: Collection-error expansion opens the agent-printed path unbounded, so /dev/zero or a FIFO blocks or exhausts the grader.

H25.description: Caller updated for exec_in_tree's new return tuple.

H27.description: all_pass ignores the exit status and timeout (a passing TAP block followed by exit 1 is green), and regressions ignore exit statuses when either side is unparseable.

H28.description: prepare never removes agent-written conftest.py, ini files or bats helpers, so an agent hookwrapper can flip failures to passes before the hidden tests run.

H29.description: Counter for links dropped from snapshot trees.

H30.description: Snapshot extraction writes tar members of any size, so a huge or sparse file becomes a dense write on the grader.

H31.description: Snapshot extraction relies on data_filter alone, which misses a link that escapes only through another link in the tree.

H32.description: Marker object for oversized files in churn.

H33.description: churn reads whole files of any size (and opens non-regular files such as FIFOs), so a huge file or FIFO exhausts or blocks the grader.

H34.description: churn diffs oversized files instead of counting them as changed unread.

H35.description: gate_verdict follows a symlinked feedback file (reading outside the sandbox) and reads it unbounded, possibly blocking on a FIFO.

H36.description: review_md_verdict follows a symlinked review.md and reads it unbounded.

H37.description: envelope_texts reads the envelope JSON without a size bound or non-regular-file refusal.

H38.description: combined_findings reads sandbox files unbounded and does not refuse a path through a symlinked parent directory outside the sandbox.

H39.description: The contamination scan has no pattern for ~/, $HOME/ or /proc/*/environ and /var/run, so home-relative and secret-bearing reads are not flagged.

H40.description: Host-mode allowed roots exempt the caller's ~/.claude, ~/.claude.json, ~/.codex and ~/.aws credential stores from the outside_path check.

H41.description: outside() treats /proc/<pid>/environ etc. and /var/run as allowed and never flags home-relative paths.

H42.description: Bash scanning skips every one-component /x/ word as a regex (so `cd /root/` is never flagged) and ignores ~/ and $HOME/ words.

H43.description: Callers pass the sandbox root to gate_verdict's new signature.

H44.description: Caller passes the sandbox root to review_md_verdict's new signature.

H45.description: For refactor tasks hidden_tests is the fixture suite (test_command) instead of the structural check, so the pass rate and accuracy measure the wrong assertion.

H46.description: Snapshot trees of refactor tasks are graded with test_command rather than the structural check plus suite, so per-gate verdict accuracy is wrong.

H47.description: Records the oversized-file count in grade.json.

H48.description: Self-check treats the suite and hidden tests as green from counts alone, ignoring exit status, timeout and parse errors.

H49.description: --executor host runs agent code unisolated on the host with no opt-in or warning.

H50.description: Header comment documenting new schema checks.

H51.description: Help-text line range extended to cover the longer header.

H52.description: A refactor task with a non-null regression_command is accepted although the grader uses test_command as its regression check.

H53.description: Validation does not require grader_protected to list every fixture/tests/ file, so agent-edited fixture tests can survive grading.

H54.description: Test setup opts into host grading.

I01.description: The contamination scan's ABS_WORD/GIT_HIST heuristics flag ordinary agent text (slash commands like /review-sprint, heredoc prose, sed ranges) as outside_path or git_history, marking clean runs contaminated.

I02.description: Fixes the grader 1.3.0 oracle detector and repo-name exemption, added after head.

I03.description: Further fixes to later-added oracle detector code.

I04.description: Fixes later-added repo-name exemption, oracle bounds and corpus hash.

I05.description: Test for later eval_only feature in pipeline-run.

I06.description: Test for later oracle_open toggle check.

I07.description: Changes to the later 1.3.0 oracle detector's error-result handling.

I08.description: New labels sync feature unrelated to head code.

I09.description: Review fixes to the later --sync-labels feature.

I10.description: Audit fixes to the later --sync-labels feature.
